correctness.rationale: A fixed-period output has a same-period predecessor precisely when the corresponding four-state Rule-54 Boolean de Bruijn product has a positive diagonal; this remains correct for n=1 and n=2. Exhaustive deterministic closure gives exactly 109 reachable products and a 109-coordinate exact vector identity T^8 f-2T^7 f+T^6 f-T^5 f-T^4 f+T^3 f-T^2 f=0, which by multiplication with further T proves the recurrence at all n>=8. Exact initial coefficients yield the displayed rational GF. Direct enumeration n=1..18 matches, and quartic factorization proves the asymptotic and dominant coefficient.

value.rationale: The finite same-ring Rule-54 image is a natural one-step information-loss and Garden-of-Eden invariant. The result counts it at every length, identifies a nontrivial quartic dominant growth rate with coefficient one, provides exact unattainable counts and finite-size oscillations, and separates cyclic predecessor existence from mere bi-infinite image-language membership. The 109-state-to-order-six recurrence reduction gives substantive structural information beyond an arbitrary finite table.
